policy: No package may be added to any workspace package.json without explicit Human Gate approval and a matching entry here.

packages.zod: Runtime contract validation across shared, IPC, and API boundaries
packages.vitest: Executable unit, contract, and acceptance test runner
packages.@playwright/test: End-to-end Electron and web workflow verification
packages.eslint: Static boundary, complexity, and code-quality enforcement
packages.drizzle-orm: Typed SQL schema and query builder
packages.pgvector: PostgreSQL vector similarity bindings for Knowledge Base
packages.@aws-sdk/client-s3: S3 and MinIO object storage client

packages.@types/node: TypeScript definitions for Node.js APIs in apps/api, apps/desktop main, and test harnesses
packages.@types/pg: TypeScript definitions for pg driver in apps/api
packages.@types/react: TypeScript definitions for React in apps/desktop renderer
packages.@types/react-dom: TypeScript definitions for React DOM in apps/desktop renderer
packages.typescript-eslint: Strict TypeScript ESLint parser and rules (no-explicit-any, boundary rules, complexity)
packages.drizzle-kit: SQL migration generation and runner for apps/api/src/db

packages.argon2: OWASP-compliant Argon2id password hashing in apps/api (1.1); preferred over bcrypt/scrypt
packages.jose: Zero-dependency ESM-native JWT signing and verification for access and rotating refresh tokens in apps/api (1.1); preferred over jsonwebtoken
packages.@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner: Presigned S3/MinIO upload and download URL generation in apps/api (1.3), companion to approved @aws-sdk/client-s3
packages.better-sqlite3: Embedded SQLite driver for local read-only cache and offline draft recovery in apps/desktop/src/main/db (1.4)
packages.@types/better-sqlite3: Strict TypeScript definitions for better-sqlite3 in apps/desktop main process (1.4)
packages.lucide-react: Tree-shakeable vector icon library for 3-column workspace sidebar, file explorer, tabs, and offline indicator in apps/desktop renderer (1.2-1.4)
packages.react-resizable-panels: Accessible keyboard-navigable resizable 3-column IDE split panes in apps/desktop renderer (1.2)

packages.fast-xml-parser: Zero-native pure-JS XML parser for PubMed E-utilities efetch XML (2.1) and embedded PDF XMP metadata packets (2.3); preferred over legacy callback-based xml2js and brittle regex XML parsing
packages.@citation-js/core: Modular ESM-native bibliography core with built-in TypeScript types for BibTeX/RIS normalization in apps/api (2.3); preferred over citation-js meta-package which runs a patch-package postinstall script and bundles unused Phase 3 plugins
packages.@citation-js/plugin-bibtex: Bidirectional BibTeX parser and Zotero-compatible serializer plugin for @citation-js/core in apps/api (2.3); preferred over hand-rolled BibTeX grammars
packages.@citation-js/plugin-ris: Bidirectional RIS parser and serializer plugin for @citation-js/core in apps/api (2.3); preferred over ad-hoc line-by-line RIS parsers
packages.pdfjs-dist: Official Mozilla pdf.js ESM engine with native TypeScript types used in apps/desktop for the integrated academic PDF viewer (2.4) and in apps/api legacy Node build for deterministic PDF text and XMP metadata extraction (2.3, reusable for Phase 5 RAG); preferred over pdf-parse which bundles outdated pdf.js v1.10 with CommonJS quirks
packages.@tanstack/react-table: Headless strictly-typed table state engine for the Reference Manager sortable/filterable workspace table in apps/desktop (2.2) and reused in Phase 6 CSV/XLSX grid; preferred over heavy commercial ag-grid-react
